name: List Replicability Number of Singletons plus Empty Set
proof: This is a proper extremal class of VC dimension one: its $n+1$ concepts and its shattered sets are respectively the empty set plus the $n$ singletons. The cited theorem gives $\mathrm{SCdim}=1$, and $\mathrm{LR}=\mathrm{SCdim}+1$ gives $\mathrm{LR}=2$.
